title: [Advisory] Danfoss AK-SM 800A: Multiple Pre-Authentication Remote Code Execution
summary: Multiple critical vulnerabilities recently fixed in Danfoss AK-SM 800A refrigeration controllers allow unauthenticated remote code execution and complete device takeover. Attackers could disrupt refrigeration, install persistent malicious firmware, or render controllers inoperable.
